source: scripts/settings/settings.json of the firmware branch fix/existing-lp0-implementation at 7bae042 (2026-10-20), as the public ble-settings-app bundles it (settings-v8.1.0.json); group, unit, since_firmware and descriptions carried over from catalog.json (firmware 7.3.0) by name; the additions of 8.0.0 and 8.1.0 described from the firmware's LP0 documentation and the settings app's release note

settings.name: tracker_type
settings.description: The firmware type reported in the status message (5 RangerEdge, 10 FenceEdge, 7 scanner, and so on).

settings.name: status_send_interval
settings.description: Seconds between status messages (battery, temperature, errors, versions).

settings.name: data_log
settings.description: Store records to the external flash log.

settings.name: wifi_scan_interval
settings.description: Interval settings wifi_scan_interval (0x19) and wifi_scan_aggregated_interval (0x1A).

settings.name: wifi_scan_aggregated_interval
settings.description: Interval settings wifi_scan_interval (0x19) and wifi_scan_aggregated_interval (0x1A).

settings.name: device_name
settings.description: The name the device advertises over Bluetooth.

settings.name: device_pin
settings.description: device_pin 0x2A (4 ASCII digits, 0000 = off) locks BLE access;

settings.name: memfault_send_interval
settings.description: Interval memfault_send_interval (0x34, default 0).

settings.name: flash_status_interval
settings.description: Periodic every flash_status_interval (0x43, default 0 = off since 6.12.0), or on cmd_get_flash_status (0xB3).

settings.name: wifi_scan_report_zero_connections_found
settings.description: Empty result messages are only sent when wifi_scan_report_zero_connections_found (0x48) is true.

settings.name: lr_send_flag
settings.description: Bit mask of the message ports sent over LoRaWAN.

settings.name: flash_store_flag
settings.description: Bit mask of the message ports stored to the flash log.

settings.name: sat_send_flag
settings.description: Bit mask of the message ports queued for the satellite modem.

settings.name: ble_adv
settings.description: Bluetooth advertising on or off; a change restarts advertising.

settings.name: ble_scan_duration
settings.description: Interval ble_scan_interval (0x1C), duration ble_scan_duration (0x1B, ms).

settings.name: ble_scan_interval
settings.description: Interval ble_scan_interval (0x1C), duration ble_scan_duration (0x1B, ms).

settings.name: ble_scan_aggregated_interval
settings.description: Interval ble_scan_aggregated_interval (0x1D);

settings.name: ble_scan_filter
settings.description: filter ble_scan_filter (0x1E: 0 none, 1 Smart Parks manufacturer id 0x0A61, 2 configured ble_scan_manufacturer_id 0x72, 3 phones).

settings.name: cmdq_enabled
settings.description: Switches the cardiac tag scanner on. Switching it off while a scan runs stops the scan.

settings.name: cmdq_scan_duration
settings.description: How long the module scans for the tag during a short scan. Long enough that small differences in timekeeping do not make it miss the advertisement.

settings.name: cmdq_search_interval
settings.description: How long the module waits between scans. During an immediate or a long scan it scans for this duration instead, because it has no idea yet when the tag speaks. Set it to the tag's advertising interval.

settings.name: cmdq_on_no_detection_wait_duration
settings.description: How long to wait after a long scan found nothing before trying again.

settings.name: cmdq_searched_mac_address
settings.description: The Bluetooth address of the cardiac tag this device follows. One device follows one tag; its readings are stored as measurements of this device (decision D282).

settings.name: cmdq_reporting_interval
settings.description: How often the detections held in the buffer are composed into a port 15 message and sent over LoRaWAN, satellite or Bluetooth.

settings.name: cmdq_report_zero_messages_to_be_sent
settings.description: Report an empty port 15 message when no detection was made between two reporting intervals. A debugging aid: it proves the scanner is running.

settings.name: ble_scan_manufacturer_id
settings.description: filter ble_scan_filter (0x1E: 0 none, 1 Smart Parks manufacturer id 0x0A61, 2 configured ble_scan_manufacturer_id 0x72, 3 phones).

settings.name: lr_gps_interval
settings.description: Seconds between LoRa GNSS scans (the LR1110 radio); 0 disables them.

settings.name: gnss_assisted_scan
settings.description: Send the LoRa GNSS satellite data for assisted (cloud) positioning.

settings.name: lr_adr
settings.description: The fixed data rate when the ADR profile is custom.

settings.name: lr_region
settings.description: lr_region (0x0F) selects the frequency plan, values 1 to 13.

settings.name: app_key
settings.description: The LoRaWAN application key (OTAA).

settings.name: device_eui
settings.description: The LoRaWAN device EUI.

settings.name: app_eui
settings.description: The LoRaWAN application (join) EUI.

settings.name: lr_messaging_retry_interval
settings.description: Queued by cmd_send_lr_message (0xC4, up to 46 bytes of text) and retried per lr_messaging_retry_interval (0x31) and lr_messaging_retry_count (0x32).

settings.name: lr_messaging_retry_count
settings.description: Queued by cmd_send_lr_message (0xC4, up to 46 bytes of text) and retried per lr_messaging_retry_interval (0x31) and lr_messaging_retry_count (0x32).

settings.name: rejoin_interval
settings.description: Device joins on boot and after rejoin_interval (0x35, default 3600 s).

settings.name: lr_adr_profile
settings.description: ADR profile: 0 network controlled, 1 mobile long range, 2 mobile low power, 3 custom.

settings.name: lp0_focus_offloading
settings.description: When on, routine fixes, scans and scheduled sends wait while an offload is prepared and running. Firmware 8.1.

settings.name: lp0_signal_checks
settings.description: Six bytes: the checks on (1), CAD veto (1), minimum RSSI check (1), minimum RSSI magnitude in dBm (100 means -100 dBm), background margin check (1), minimum margin in dB. Firmware 8.1.

settings.name: lp0_statistics_interval
settings.description: Seconds between an offload station's reports of itself on port 23; 0 disables them. Firmware 8.1.

settings.name: ublox_send_interval
settings.description: Seconds between u-blox GNSS positions sent over LoRaWAN; 0 disables periodic positions.

settings.name: gps_resend_interval
settings.description: Seconds between resends of the last position on port 16; 0 disables them.

settings.name: horizontal_accuracy
settings.description: horizontal_accuracy 0x13 (m) is the acceptance threshold for a fix;

settings.name: cold_fix_timeout
settings.description: hot_fix_timeout 0x17 and cold_fix_timeout 0x16 are u16 seconds.

settings.name: hot_fix_timeout
settings.description: hot_fix_timeout 0x17 and cold_fix_timeout 0x16 are u16 seconds.

settings.name: satellite_send_interval
settings.description: Seconds between satellite (Iridium) sessions; 0 disables them.

settings.name: fence_enabled
settings.description: The electric fence monitor on or off; reported as a status feature bit.

settings.name: fence_interval
settings.description: fence_enabled (0x3F), fence_interval (0x40, seconds), fence_sampling_length (0x41, s), fence_mv_scaling_factor (0x42).

settings.name: fence_sampling_length
settings.description: fence_enabled (0x3F), fence_interval (0x40, seconds), fence_sampling_length (0x41, s), fence_mv_scaling_factor (0x42).

settings.name: fence_mv_scaling_factor
settings.description: fence_enabled (0x3F), fence_interval (0x40, seconds), fence_sampling_length (0x41, s), fence_mv_scaling_factor (0x42).

settings.name: external_switch_detection_reporting_interval
settings.description: Port 20, periodic status every external_switch_detection_reporting_interval (0x81): 99 05 [state u8] [count u32 LE].

settings.name: external_switch_counter_enabled
settings.description: When state is 2 the device is in impulse counter mode (external_switch_counter_enabled 0x85) and the count is impulse_count.

settings.name: lp0_master_key
settings.description: The 16-byte key every tracker and offload station of one LP0 cluster share; devices with different master keys cannot discover each other. All zeros is the firmware's default. Firmware 8.1.

commands.name: cmd_join
commands.description: Rejoin the LoRaWAN network. Response: status uplink on FPort 4 after join

commands.name: cmd_reset
commands.description: Reboot the device (sys_reboot). No response

commands.name: cmd_send_all_val
commands.description: Response: all values as TLV on FPort 30

commands.name: cmd_send_single_val
commands.description: arg: value id (0xD0..0xEF). Response: `id len value` on FPort 30

commands.name: cmd_send_status
commands.description: Response: status message on FPort 4 to the requesting channel

commands.name: cmd_send_position
commands.description: Response: msg_last_position 0xFE on FPort 31

commands.name: cmd_reset_gps
commands.description: Power cycle the u-blox module. Response: cmd confirm on FPort 31

commands.name: cmd_send_all_settings
commands.description: Response: settings TLV on FPort 3 (first chunk over LoRaWAN)

commands.name: cmd_send_single_setting
commands.description: arg: setting id. Response: `id len value` on FPort 3

commands.name: cmd_reset_initial_position
commands.description: arg: 1 byte. Reset stored reference position to gps_init_lon/lat

commands.name: cmd_reset_initial_time
commands.description: Reset device clock from init_time setting

commands.name: cmd_clear_nvs
commands.description: Erase all stored settings (factory reset of NVS)

commands.name: cmd_reset_to_def_settings
commands.description: Restore settings.json defaults

commands.name: cmd_send_status_lr
commands.description: Force a status uplink over LoRaWAN regardless of origin

commands.name: cmd_send_lr_fix
commands.description: Perform LR11xx GNSS scan now. Response: FPort 1 (and 5)

commands.name: cmd_set_location_and_time
commands.description: arg: lon i32 (deg*1e7), lat i32, unix time u32, 12 bytes LE. Seeds assisted GNSS and the clock

commands.name: cmd_get_wifi_scan
commands.description: Perform Wi-Fi scan now. Response: FPort 10 (and 6)

commands.name: cmd_get_ble_scan
commands.description: Perform BLE scan now. Response: FPort 11

commands.name: cmd_get_flash_status
commands.description: Response: FPort 14

commands.name: cmd_get_lr_satellite_data
commands.description: Response: FPort 5

commands.name: cmd_get_ublox_satellite_data
commands.description: Response: FPort 9

commands.name: cmd_almanac_update
commands.description: arg: up to 250 bytes, stacked 20 byte almanac chunks (byte 0 of each chunk is the SV id, 128 = header; update executes when header received)

commands.name: cmd_get_mac
commands.description: Response: msg_mac_id 0xFD on FPort 31

commands.name: cmd_get_ublox_fix
commands.description: Perform u-blox fix now. Response: FPort 2 (fixed for LoRaWAN in 6.4.0)

commands.name: cmd_reset_lr
commands.description: Reset the LR11xx modem

commands.name: cmd_flash_clear
commands.description: Erase flash log. Response: cmd confirm FPort 31

commands.name: cmd_flash_get_all
commands.description: arg: port (0 = all). Response: FPort 29 records, then cmd confirm

commands.name: cmd_flash_get_from_head
commands.description: arg: port u32, start u32, count u32 (12 bytes LE). Response: FPort 29 records, then cmd confirm

commands.name: cmd_s_band_send
commands.description: Send status and short position over S-band (RangerEdge 1.7+ only)

commands.name: cmd_set_operation_mode_com_th
commands.description: arg: mode byte for the communication thread (debug)

commands.name: cmd_disable_flash_th
commands.description: Disable the flash thread

commands.name: cmd_disable_bt_th
commands.description: Disable Bluetooth

commands.name: cmd_set_operation_mode_main_th
commands.description: arg: mode byte for the main thread (debug)

commands.name: cmd_check_pin
commands.description: arg: 16 bytes (PIN or AppKey) to unlock a PIN protected device (BLE use)

commands.name: cmd_set_hibernation_mode
commands.description: Enter hibernation (everything off until magnet). Wiki: `C3 00`, base64 `wwA=`

commands.name: cmd_send_lr_message
commands.description: arg: up to 46 ASCII bytes, queued as FPort 28 uplink (msg 0x90)

commands.name: cmd_read_all_lr_messages
commands.description: Deliver stored incoming messages (BLE use)

commands.name: cmd_send_sat_buffer
commands.description: Flush the RockBLOCK send buffer now (adds a status message if empty)

commands.name: cmd_lp0_command
commands.description: arg: 1 byte LP0 command (experimental)

commands.name: cmd_fence_measure
commands.description: arg: 1 byte. Perform fence measurement now. Response: FPort 12

commands.name: cmd_aggregated_bt_scan
commands.description: Compose and send BLE aggregated message now. Response: FPort 7

commands.name: cmd_single_bt_scan
commands.description: Perform BLE scan now. Response: FPort 11

commands.name: cmd_bt_disconnect
commands.description: Drop the current BLE connection

commands.name: cmd_send_bt_cmdq_results
commands.description: Send latest CMDQ results. Response: FPort 15

commands.name: cmd_decouple_collar
commands.description: CollarEdge drop-off: powers the P3 connector for 5 s. Wiki: `CD 00`

commands.name: cmd_send_timestamp
commands.description: Response: msg_timestamp 0x97 on FPort 18

commands.name: cmd_offload_start
commands.description: Start an offload of saved records: medium (0 LP0, 1 LoRaWAN, 2 satellite, 3 Bluetooth), selection (0 all, 1 confirmed, 2 unconfirmed), port (0 all, or 1 to 32). Firmware 8.1.

commands.name: cmd_offload_cancel
commands.description: Cancel the running offload: the job id as uint32, or 0 for whatever runs. Firmware 8.1.

commands.name: cmd_flash_clear_confirmed
commands.description: Erase whole flash sectors from the oldest records on, as long as every record in them was confirmed delivered over the given medium (or any). Firmware 8.1.

values.name: last_position_time
values.description: unix time of last valid fix

values.name: last_accel_int_time
values.description: unix time of last accelerometer interrupt
